messages:
maria-support: Customer is hitting repeated 429s for short bursts. They say it's intermittent and only when requests come through our partner LB. They provided curl tests showing both an API key and an Authorization bearer token in the same request, plus X-Forwarded-For header. Suspect scoping fallthrough: org limit firing instead of project/key. Repro steps below.
alex-eng: can you paste the exact headers they send? quick guess: proxy might strip project header so we fallback to IP-based attribution which hits nat pool quota.
maria-support: headers they sent (redacted):
```
Authorization: Bearer sk-live-REDACTED
X-Api-Key: proj_abc123
X-Forwarded-For: 34.82.11.101
X-Org-Id: org-777
```
They say X-Org-Id isn't set reliably by partner, sometimes missing. When missing they still include both auth methods and XFF.
ryan-sre: hmmm if X-Org-Id missing and both API key + bearer present, our auth priority code should prefer API key -> project -> org. But there was a recent PR changing accept-order for bearer tokens to be considered as org-scoped when key not verified. Could cause org fallback. I'll pull logs.
infra-bot: deploy/lookup succeeded: auth-service v2.11.3 running on prod-us-east-1. Recent deploy 1718880000. No rollbacks.
sarah-qa: reproduced locally with a tiny script: when X-Org-Id absent and Authorization malformed (extra whitespace) our verifier rejects the bearer quickly and then attribution falls back to IP. Under our nat pool rate that hits org quota because NAT mapped to a customer org for other flows. Short bursts show 429s within 15s windows.
alex-eng: can you share the repro script? that helps support provide customer steps.
maria-support: here's minimal repro they ran (sanitized):
```
for i in {1..80}; do 
  curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-live-REDACTED" \
    -H "X-Api-Key: proj_abc123" \
    -H "X-Forwarded-For: 34.82.11.101" \
    "https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate" &
  done; wait
```
They see ~10-20% 429s within first 40 requests, then fine.
ryan-sre: logs from auth-service for that request window show these lines: `auth: key=proj_abc123 verified=true -> scope=project:abc123` for some requests, but others show `auth: bearer=sk-live-REDACTED verify_error=invalid_format -> fallback=ip:34.82.11.101 -> scope=org:org-999` — different org assigned by IP affinity. That will explain mixed attribution and unexpected org-level throttles. There might be a race where key verification times out and we fallback early.
oncall-eric: I reported a tracing trace-id to the customer and asked for one failing request header dump. Also opened ticket SRT-4921 to track potential regression introduced in 1718880000.
alex-eng: short-term mitigation ideas: 1) instruct partner to always pass X-Org-Id or ensure API keys are included alone (not duping auth modes) 2) on our side, change fallback so that if API key present we block fallback to org until key verification timeout threshold elapses (atomic check). Could reduce false org attribution.
ryan-sre: agree. quick fix: bump key verification timeout to 250ms for auth-service and add synchronous key-preference check. I'll propose a hotfix branch and smoke test in staging. Will attach telemetry to measure how often we hit the fallback path.
sarah-qa: I'll add a small regression test: repeated parallel requests with mixed header permutations to assert all requests with valid API key get project scope even if bearer fails.
maria-support: I've told customer we're investigating and asked them to send a failing request id. Also offered a short-term workaround: ensure only the API key or only the bearer is sent (no dual auth) and add X-Org-Id header if possible. They were able to patch partner flow but want us to fix on our side too.
ryan-sre: planned actions: 1) revert-or-fix PR check for bearer priority (SRT-4921) 2) hotfix auth-service timeout/priority change (patch PR 4921-hotfix) 3) add telemetry counters for fallback-attribution hits and nat-ip-mapped-org collisions 4) follow up with support to confirm customer no longer sees 429s.
maria-support: thanks — will update the customer once SRT-4921 has a PR link. :thumbsup:
